title: 第8章 一路碾压
slug: 武破九荒全本免费-武破九荒最新章节列表
content_zh:
吴斗被摔得七晕八素，他爬起来看着台上的萧叶，直接懵了。
三位村长坐在同一张桌子上。
萧老头，怎么回事，不是说萧叶才苏醒过来吗？他的实力可不像才突破炼体九重啊。”头发稀疏的石战眼中精芒一闪。
萧天雄满脸震撼，苦笑摇头道：“这个，我也不清楚。”
看萧天雄的样子不像作假，石战和吴狮对视一眼，神情各异。
“看来这个小家伙不简单啊。”良久，石战才幽幽说道。
“哼！他再厉害，也无法和萧腾相比。”吴狮冷哼道。
他让自己的孙女送亲帖给萧腾，也就是将宝都押在对方身上，当然不希望萧腾会输给萧叶了。
事实上，所有人都坚信，萧腾在使用了蛟蛇血后，实力已经远超萧叶了。
在众人惊愕之际，萧叶已经走下了擂台。
“臭小子，好样的！”萧阳开心的笑着，萧叶可真是给他大大的长了回脸啊。
高兴之余，他没有再去追问萧叶实力的问题。
选婚比武继续进行着，一位位少年走上擂台，他们大多数实力相差不多，甚至要在数百招以后，才能结束决斗。
有萧叶一招败敌的惊艳表现在前，这样的决斗无疑要失色不少，连擂台下的欢呼声都稀疏了很多。
同时，有不少相貌出色的少女，悄悄的将目光投向萧叶所在方向，眼中异彩涟涟。
终于，半个时辰后，又轮到萧叶上台了。当他的对手听到萧叶的名字后，脸色瞬间变了，面色挣扎了片刻，鼓起勇气向萧叶发动了攻击，却依旧被萧叶一招击败。
萧叶数次上台，每一次都是一招败敌，到最后凡是萧叶上场的时候，场中便会爆发出震天的欢呼。
萧叶一路碾压，在混战中毫无敌手，压得所有人抬不起头来，牢牢吸引了场中所有人的目光，成为最瞩目的焦点。
场下的少女芳心荡漾，对坐在五张虎座上少年的关注都少了很多。
孤身一人，力压所有参加混战的同辈，这是何等的风采和强势！

甚至有些容貌出色的少女忍不住了，面含羞色的来到萧阳罗梅兰面前，递上了亲帖。
一般而言，女方只会给一位男方递交亲帖，但这也不是一定的。在青阳镇的历史上，就出现过女方后悔，转投亲帖的。因为选婚是双向的，男方可以选择女方，女方也可以选择男方。
可这种情况，毕竟极少出现。
有第一位少女带头，立刻引起了轰动，带动了其他少女纷纷投递亲帖。
这个情形，惊得众人目瞪口呆。
转眼间，罗梅兰面前就有了厚厚一叠亲帖，将她乐得合不拢嘴。
此前她还在因为萧叶没有收到亲帖而心情不佳呢，现在一切不愉快都烟消云散了。
“尼玛，老子要自杀，我的女神居然转投亲帖了！”
“好哇，我们一起吧，我家月儿也转投亲帖了，我心碎了。”场中不时响起骂骂咧咧的声音，哀嚎声四起，一道道充满杀意的目光，落在萧叶身上。
“混蛋！”萧腾坐在第一把虎椅上，大力握紧扶手，身躯愤怒的颤抖着，使得扶手都变形了。
转投亲帖的少女中，有一大半都是给他投递过的，这绝对是赤裸裸的羞辱啊！
“混蛋，混蛋！我一定要踩死你！”萧腾内心疯狂的咆哮着。
因为转投亲帖的少女过多，现场一时间混乱起来，使得萧大山不得不出来主持场面，宣布着选婚比武继续进行。
擂台上的萧叶眉头一皱，参加选婚的男子有着六百多位，这样比下去，还不知道什么时候才能结束，他可有些不耐烦了。
这就好比让一个大人，和幼童打架一样。
“山叔，让他们一起上吧。”萧叶对萧大山道。
原本嘈杂的现场突然安静了下来，落针可闻，所有人都呆滞的望着萧叶，就连三位村长都震惊了。
让所有人一起上？这也太夸张了吧！
“胡闹！”萧天雄站起身大喝道。
选婚比武的混战，是一轮轮的筛选，直至选出最强的一个人，才能坐上第六把虎椅。

如今混战才过去一半，这也就是说，至少还有着三百人没有被淘汰，而这三百人当中，还有不少参加过数次选婚的老油条。
让萧叶一个人同时和这么多人打？怎么可能会赢！拳脚无眼，到时候收不住手，萧叶还会有生命之忧。

content_en:
Wu Dou was knocked unconscious. He got up and looked at Xiao Ye on the stage, stunned.
The three village chiefs were sitting at the same table.
Old man Xiao, what's going on? Didn't Xiao Ye just wake up? His strength doesn't look like he just broke through to the ninth level of body refining. " Shi Zhan, who had thin hair, had a gleam in his eyes.
Xiao Tianxiong's face was full of shock, he smiled bitterly and shook his head: "I don't know about this either. "
Xiao Tianxiong didn't look like he was faking it. Shi Zhan and Wu Shi looked at each other with different expressions.
"It seems that this little guy is not simple. "After a long time, Shi Zhan said quietly.
"Hmph! No matter how powerful he is, he can't compare with Xiao Teng. "Wu Shi snorted coldly.
He asked his granddaughter to send a wedding invitation to Xiao Teng, which meant that he was betting on the other party. Of course, he didn't want Xiao Teng to lose to Xiao Ye.
In fact, everyone firmly believes that Xiao Teng's strength has far exceeded Xiao Ye after using the dragon's blood.
When everyone was shocked, Xiao Ye had already walked off the ring.
"Brat, good job! "Xiao Yang smiled happily, Xiao Ye really changed his face a lot.
While he was happy, he didn't ask any more questions about Xiao Ye's strength.
The marriage selection contest continued, with young men stepping onto the ring one after another. Most of them were about the same strength, and it would take hundreds of moves before the duel could end.
With Xiao Ye's amazing performance of defeating the enemy in one move, such a duel would undoubtedly be a lot less impressive, and even the cheers under the arena would be much thinner.
At the same time, there were many outstanding-looking girls who quietly cast their gazes in the direction of Xiao Ye, with brilliant eyes.
Finally, half an hour later, it was Xiao Ye's turn to take the stage again. When his opponent heard Xiao Ye's name, his face changed instantly. He struggled for a moment and mustered up the courage to attack Xiao Ye, but was still defeated by Xiao Ye with one move.
Xiao Ye came on stage several times, and each time he defeated the enemy with one move. In the end, whenever Xiao Ye came on the stage, the audience would burst into cheers.
Xiao Ye crushed him all the way and had no opponent in the melee. He was so overwhelmed that everyone could not lift their heads. He firmly attracted the attention of everyone in the field and became the center of attention.
The girls in the audience were filled with excitement, and they paid much less attention to the boy sitting on the five tiger seats.
Alone, overwhelming all peers participating in the melee, how elegant and powerful is this!
Even some girls with outstanding looks couldn't help it, and shyly came to Henry Luo Meilan and handed over the wedding invitation.
Generally speaking, a woman will only submit wedding invitations to one man, but this is not certain. In the history of Qingyang Town, there have been instances where women regretted their marriage and turned to marriage. Because marriage selection is a two-way street, the man can choose the woman, and the woman can choose the man.
But this situation rarely occurs after all.
The first girl took the lead and immediately caused a sensation, leading other girls to submit wedding invitations one after another.
This situation shocked everyone.
In the blink of an eye, Luo Meilan had a thick stack of wedding notes in front of her, which made her smile from ear to ear.
Before, she was still in a bad mood because Xiao Ye didn't receive the wedding invitation, but now all the unhappiness has disappeared.
"Nima, I'm going to commit suicide, but my goddess actually turned to the wedding party! "
"Okay, let's go together. My Yue'er has also switched to wedding invitations, and I'm heartbroken. " From time to time, cursing and wailing sounds could be heard in the field, and eyes full of murderous intent fell on Xiao Ye.
"Asshole! "Xiao Teng sat on the first tiger chair, clenching the armrests vigorously, his body shaking angrily, causing the armrests to deform.
Most of the girls who forwarded their love posts were sent to him. This is absolutely a naked humiliation!
“Asshole, bastard! I must trample you to death! "Xiao Teng roared crazily in his heart.
Because there were too many girls who submitted their wedding invitations, the scene became chaotic for a while, forcing Xiao Dashan to come out to preside over the scene and announce the continuation of the marriage contest.
ArenaXiao Ye frowned. There were more than 600 men participating in the marriage selection. If the comparison continued like this, he still didn't know when it would end. He was a little impatient.
This is like letting an adult fight with a child.
"Uncle Shan, let them come together." Xiao Ye said to Xiao Dashan.
The originally noisy scene suddenly became quiet. You could hear a needle drop. Everyone looked at Xiao Ye blankly. Even the three village chiefs were shocked.
Let everyone come together? This is too exaggerated!
"Nonsense!" Xiao Tianxiong stood up and shouted.
The melee of the marriage selection competition is a round of screening until the strongest person is selected to sit on the sixth tiger chair.
Now the melee is only half over, which means that there are at least 300 people who have not been eliminated, and among these 300 people, there are many veterans who have participated in several marriage selections.
Let Xiao Ye fight so many people at the same time? How could it be possible to win! Fists and feet have no eyes. If he cannot hold back his hands when the time comes, Xiao Ye will still be in danger of his life.
